result.summary: This pull request adds functional test coverage for the mining IPC interface when BlockWaitOptions feeThreshold is set to MAX_MONEY. It verifies that template generation ignores mempool fee increases and only triggers on chain tip updates or timeouts.
result.problem: The mining IPC waitNext interface had no test coverage for clients configured to ignore fee changes and wait exclusively for new block tips, risking silent regressions in template notification logic.

resolved_concerns: davidgumberg pointed out the test originally passed spuriously due to 1-second fee polling delays in WaitAndCreateNewBlock; author adjusted sleep times and timeouts accordingly.
jeanpablojp suggested asserting that CreateNewBlock is never invoked during MAX_MONEY timeouts; author adopted this.
enirox001 noted an unnecessary transfer after the timeout; author simplified the sequence to consume existing mempool transactions directly.

result.card: PR #35598 adds functional test coverage for the mining IPC waitNext interface when feeThreshold is set to MAX_MONEY. This ensures that template generation ignores mempool fee increases and only triggers upon chain tip updates or timeouts, a scenario relevant to external template providers such as Stratum v2 implementations. The change was extracted from PR #33922 where it was out of scope. Reviewers enirox001, jeanpablojp, and davidgumberg contributed detailed timing and assertion feedback, all of which has been incorporated into the current push.
